note: IMPORTANT: this source PDF does not include an answer key for Part I (unlike the MCAS and NY Science batches, which had official answer tables). Correct answers for all 31 extracted items were determined independently from general grade-5 social-studies/civics/geography/history knowledge (definitions, well-established historical facts, and reasoning fully supported by the text given with each item), not copied from any answer key. Flag for extra scrutiny in Steps 2-3/review since there is no official answer to cross-check against - if a rewritten item's correct answer is in doubt, verify it against the original wording before staging. This is a different administration (Nov 2006) from the previously-merged NY G5 Social Studies batch (Nov 2008), so no content overlap.
